svg.title: compareAndSwap: compare and change atomically
svg.desc: If the value is 1, expected=1 and value=2 succeeds. If another node already stored 2, that submission returns false and preserves its value and TTL. A store failure is a failed HaiResult, not false. expected=undefined means create only if absent.
